game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace, a terrace under the aurora: the snow ranger must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against snow wraiths.
theme: Snowy Hold – Aurora Terrace: a terrace under the aurora
core_gameplay_loop: In Aurora Terrace, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against snow wraiths. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the snow ranger ahead. Then check the spells value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the larder door by solving code steps involving spells that move the snow ranger forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the larder door first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Aurora Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Aurora Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
